minor.issue: Still returns only {message: 'Decision updated successfully'} with no decision body. The frontend now works around this by merging locally in applyEmbedSeed, but the broader anti-pattern remains: PUTs that don't return the updated resource force every caller to maintain a parallel mirror. Not blocking, but worth standardising in a future pass.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Not blocking.

action_items: PRIMARY: No action needed — P2 MyDezider pre-seed is now fully working end-to-end. Both target acceptance criteria pass.

OPTIONAL HARDENING (not blocking): each Step component still does `decision.options.map(...)` / `decision.factors.map(...)` without `|| []` fallback. Add defensive `(decision.options || [])` guards to Step2..Step10 to prevent future regressions if a similar state-overwrite bug is reintroduced.
OPTIONAL BACKEND CLEANUP: change PUT /api/decisions/{decision_id} to return the updated decision body (not just {message}). Removes a class of mirror-state bugs going forward.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence the deprecation console warnings (cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: iter86 fix is minimal and correct: merges new options into the existing decision state instead of trusting the PUT response shape. Good defensive coding.

DecisionContext.fetchDecision's catch block still calls router.back() unconditionally for any thrown error. If a future bug surfaces a render error inside a Step component while on a deep-linked /prr/{id} URL, the user will again be bounced to /auth/login because the nav stack is empty. Worth restricting router.back() to network/401 errors only.
Step components reach directly into context-supplied decision.options/factors without optional chaining; latent crash sites if the decision shape ever becomes partial again.

rca_of_issue: Resolved by iter85's one-line fix. Root-cause chain (now closed): backend PUT /api/decisions/{id} returns only {message: ...} without the decision body → applyEmbedSeed previously did setDecision(resp.data) which wiped .options/.factors → Step6 .map crashed → fetchDecision catch path called router.back() which on a deep link routed to /auth/login. Fix: setDecision({...decisionData, options: [...(decisionData.options||[]), ...additions]}). Verified end-to-end via Playwright: URL stable, Step 6 with 3 options rendered, embed_seed cleared, no console TypeError.
